announcements.headline: Director/PDMR Shareholding
announcements.insight: Director dealings in a VCT are typically low-liquidity administrative events with negligible price impact on the underlying portfolio assets, reflecting standard compliance rather than strategic shifts.

announcements.headline: 1st Quarter Results
announcements.insight: As a VCT, quarterly results primarily reflect portfolio valuation changes and dividend distribution capacity rather than operational growth, making this a routine income-focused update for existing shareholders rather than a catalyst for capital appreciation.
